_comment: Copy to lab-config.json and fill in. lab-config.json is gitignored. All lab scripts read this file from the lab/ directory by default; pass -ConfigPath to override.

tenant._tenantIdHelp: Microsoft Entra tenant GUID. Get with: (Get-MgContext).TenantId or az account show --query tenantId

azure._regionHelp: Azure region for Key Vault. Use a region close to the Power Platform environment.

powerPlatform._environmentIdHelp: Leave empty to auto-resolve from environmentUrl. Get with: pac admin list

keyVault.name: kv-mcm-lab-001
keyVault._help: Key Vault names are globally unique and limited to 24 chars.

appRegistration._help: Re-runs are idempotent: if an app reg with this display name exists, it is reused (and the secret is rotated only if no credential is valid for >=30 days).

operator._runnerUpnHelp: UPN of the engineer running the lab. Granted Key Vault Secrets User role and recorded as createdBy in lab-state.json.

nonProd._help: Hard guard: every mutating script refuses to run unless this value EXACTLY equals 'I understand this lab must not target production' (case + punctuation sensitive). This prevents accidentally pointing the lab at a prod tenant. To intentionally bypass on a prod tenant (NOT recommended), pass -AllowProduction on each script call.

notification._help: Optional. Empty values are accepted by the lab; the smoke test does not require Teams. Populate to validate Teams notification end-to-end.

smoke._knownMessageIdHelp: Optional MC###### that you know exists in your tenant's Message Center. If empty, smoke test picks the first row returned by the live sync.
smoke._daysBackHelp: How many days of Message Center history to pull during the smoke test. 14 is usually enough to find rows in any tenant.

thresholds._help: Dataverse alternate key index activation can take up to ~15 min after creation. Adjust if your environment is consistently faster/slower.
